notes.title: At Gamescom
notes.content:
Our Very First Gamescom
“The absolute cherry on top? Seeing our own game out there on display, a moment we’ll never forget.”

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550003/c504cab870a375fa22ae5674c1b33704cfaf8667.jpg"]

This was our very first Gamescom as a studio and our first time showcasing Here Comes The Swarm at such a large event. We showcased with our publishers at the Infernozilla booth, going with big expectations, which Gamescom blew out of the water!

It was incredible, bigger, louder, and more exciting than we ever imagined. 


Three out of four of us from CableHook made the trip this year (the fourth was off on a well-deserved holiday), and for two of us it was indeed our very first visit to Gamescom.

It wasn’t just about our game either. We loved wandering through the halls, checking out upcoming games, marveling at the insane amount of merch, and just standing in awe at some of the jaw-dropping booth designs and art. 


It was also super nostalgic to catch glimpses of the games we grew up with. And the absolute cherry on top? Seeing our own game out there on display was a moment we’ll never forget. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550003/3b95148dc19185b2220da08b2446b55a10d4bb64.jpg"]
What We Learned
“It’s so motivating to watch people having fun.”



It’s one thing to gather feedback with a form, but there’s nothing quite like seeing players dive into your game in person. Many players powered through the demo all the way to the end, and some even went back to tackle the hardest difficulty just for the thrill of it.


That level of dedication is incredible to see, and it shows that Here Comes The Swarm is already connecting with players exactly as we hoped.


There is nothing more motivating than watching people having fun, and we can’t wait to see what surprises await and what else we will learn as more players try it.

Player Feedback and Its Importance
“Pure gold”



Player feedback is pure gold. We’ve already gotten some amazing thoughts, but honestly, we want way more! 


We want to know everything. 

What you loved, what you’d like to see improved, and even the tiniest quirks you think could make the game better. Don’t hold back, we can take it! Every bit of feedback helps us shape the game into something better, and we’re super excited to keep hearing from everyone who plays both in person and online.


Your insights are what push us to keep improving, so keep them coming, we’re all ears!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550003/6cc59e8010b93b498597b9a9ce45c378f57cbfcd.jpg"]
The Future
“This year was already fantastic, and next time we’d love to share the game with even more players.”


If we get the chance, we will absolutely be back at Gamescom! This year was already fantastic, and next time we’d love to share Here Comes The Swarm with even more players. 



There’s nothing quite like seeing someone play your game for the very first time. It’s thrilling, a little nerve-wracking, and the best way to spot all the blind spots we’d never notice ourselves after playing it so much.


We enjoyed it so much, we’re keeping our eyes wide open for exciting opportunities to showcase Here Comes The Swarm. While we don’t have news on future events just yet, stay tuned.


Finally, one thing that really stood out at Gamescom was just how many booths were focused on creating the perfect photo op. Next time, we might have to join the trend and set up a giant fiend for people to snap selfies with!


Being part of such an energetic celebration of games was inspiring, and it makes us even more excited to keep building and sharing our game with all of you.


With all our hearts, THANK YOU to everyone who stopped by the booth, played the demo, and for all the support.

- CableHook Games

notes.title: ICYMI: The First Big Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello Champions!



Here Comes The Swarm got a big update last weekend, in case you missed it, here are all the changes. With the first update comes several new additions, localization, changes, and a ton of bug fixes! Check out everything new and fixed below.

Run into a bug? Let us know on our official Discord.

Thanks and good luck with the Swarm!

-CableHook Games  

Patch Notes from August 21st & 24th.

🎮 Additions
Arcanum Fragments are now rewarded, and two socket slots in the Arcanum can be unlocked

The default language now uses the Steam language

Added voicelines for the narrator

Added localization for the majority of the languages

Added sound to the core destruction on defeat

Improved the soundscape of the settlement by adding reverbs

Added disclaimers to better describe the scope of the Skirmishes in the demo


✏️ Changes
Updated all localization with the latest translated batch

Neutral buildings can no longer be multi-selected

Removed TAA as an anti-aliasing method

Limited the possible resolutions in the dropdown, as it showed a bit too many

Building destruction audio is now also played when the building is manually removed

All abilities now also show up as buffs on the units when unlocked

Improved pathfinding performance

Added more variety to the background music, especially when the final wave is coming

Added reverb to all audio in the world

It is now not possible to leave the Arcanum tutorial

Added demo version logo

Updated the desktop icon to the Arbalist 


🛠️ Fixes
Fixed a bug where the Arcanum tutorial was misplaced when the menu HUD scale was not 1

Fixed bug where some autosaves would fail

Fixed the issue where buildings and units could be added to the same control group

Removed some spammy logs

Fixed the Gain Population talent to actually provide population

Fixed a variety of errors that could slow down the game

Units killed and lost are now also saved, so they are correct in the end screen

Fixed an issue that made it impossible to remove save games while in a match

Fixed the issue where building multiple marketplaces would break them

Fixed bug where completed research would not be unlocked when loading a save

Increased performance for longer-lasting games

Fixed bug where the tutorial lines could not be skipped during cinematics

Fixed bug where keybindings were not working as intended when swapping between grid and non-grid settings

Fixed bug where units could get stuck on a movement order

Fixed bug where the maps would be full of grass if the texture settings were low

Fixed bug where audio could, in some cases, play in the wrong ear

Fixed bug where if two buttons have the same keybind, the first one is used instead of none

Fixed some keybinds that were duplicates by default

Fixed a deep code system issue that would cause a variety of hard-to-find issues

Fixed the issue where the command audio would play on more than 1 actor in the selection

Fixed the issue where the destroy audio would play when dwellings are upgrading

notes.title: Share Your Settlements to Win!
notes.content:
Hello Champions, and happy Gamescom!  



To celebrate our recent Demo release and Gamescom, we want to see your settlements!

While we are at Gamescom (come say hi if you’re there too!), you can jump into our demo and begin your crusade against the Swarm. A big part of surviving is building a well-defended settlement. We want to see how you do just that. 


 🖼️ How to win
 Starting today through September 1st, take a screenshot of your settlement and share it on Discord, subreddit, or our social media, and you could win a $25 Steam Gift card.


That's it! Enjoy the demo, and if you are at Gamescom, you can play in person at the Infernozilla Mega Booth: B-032g in Hall 10.1! 

Good luck against the Swarm!
- CableHook Games Team

Additional Guidelines

Must be a screenshot from the demo.

Share on Discord, Reddit, Steam Community, or X to enter.

Must be able to accept the Steam gift card in USD.

Event ends September 1st.

notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
That's right! Starting today, you can dive in and try your hand at surviving the swarm. No Gamescom ticket necessary.

Get a slice of what's to come when Here Comes The Swarm arrives in Early Access, and try your hand at defending your new world. 
What to expect:
The tutorial.

A short skirmish with the Normal, Hard, and Expert difficulties.

Tiamman Deity up skills till level 4.

Tier 1 buildings and units, with a few Tier 2 ones as well.

The Arcanum with 3 slots and 10 essences.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3682340/Here_Comes_The_Swarm__Demo/"][/dynamiclink]Have feedback or run into a bug? No problem, join our official community Discord to report, we'd love to see you!

If you are in Germany, swing by and say hi over at the Infernozilla Mega Booth: B-032g in Hall 10.1.

Enjoy Champions!
    - CableHook Games
